name: deep-hull-strait
intendedUse: A strait whose navigability is constrained for deep-hull vessels by depth or tide.
modifications: Purpose-authored monochrome Night Chart route glyph for deep-hull straits.

redistribution.notes: Original geometry is distributed from this repository with the package source.

authoringNotes: Opposing coasts create the strait while a deep keel and threshold line express the vessel-specific restriction instead of an administrative padlock.
